title: Structure Homeloan to Pay off in 7 Years
body:
I see a lot of ads on my facebook for these guys who claim to have a system which allows you to shave years and years off of your mortgage. I was just wondering what the actual strategy these guys have behind their paywall is. I assumed it’s something like:
Budget and make extra repayments on your mortgage (this is my strategy and I think the only one available in Australia)
But then some of them specifically say it’s just changing the “tax structure” and not about paying any more money. I assume it’s snake oil but that they can’t outright lie, can they? Because how can you put your PPOR into any kind of structure without losing your CGT exemption, and a typical salaried employee is getting paid in their name with PAYG no two ways about it.
I guess there’s also the option of refi any existing investment loans and just max paying off the PPOR loan. I sometimes wonder if that’s what it’s all centred around, they advocated their clients to stack IP debt while the prices were going up?
Anyway, hopefully somebody can give some insight. I am always hopeful but I assume it’s a scam.
